evals.prompt: Draft a formal donor update letter with two attached financial reports and a table of grant milestones.
evals.expected_output: Apply external declaratory register, Title Case period-separated subject, letterhead and pagination standards, introduce attachments in body prose using ordered text, and omit AI attribution or em dashes in normal prose.
expectations: Applies external formal declaratory register without command modals
Uses Title Case with period separators in subject/reference line
Introduces attachments in body prose rather than a detached bottom block
Uses ordered lists rather than bullets and no U+2014 em dashes in normal prose

evals.prompt: Draft an email update to a partner summarizing three action items; the user has not said the audience is internal.
evals.expected_output: Default to external register, format structured items as ordered text rather than a Markdown/HTML table, and exclude internal paths or session notes.
expectations: Defaults to external register when internal audience is unconfirmed
Excludes repository paths, filenames, and internal deliberation
